card.summary: 500 MB per PDF (25 MB for non-PDF, converted via LibreOffice); no published account storage cap, but uploads require a manually verified account.

free_tier.stated: 500 MB per PDF (25 MB for non-PDF, converted via LibreOffice); no published account storage cap, but uploads require a manually verified account.

egress.terms: Free public document pages and a full REST API; funded by Knight Foundation so no egress billing, but it is journalism-only.

record.tooling: Full REST API at https://api.www.documentcloud.org/api plus python-documentcloud and a batch uploader github.com/MuckRock/dc_batch_upload.
record.chaining: Gated at the identity layer: upload rights require 'account verification', so the account multiplier (the usual escape hatch) is closed here.
record.limits_note: 500 MB/PDF (25 MB for Office formats); upload permission requires request + verification as a journalism organization; free because of grant funding, which the FAQ says is being replaced by 'a paid model'.
record.reliability_note: Upload is not self-serve; verification can be refused, and the funding model is explicitly in transition to paid.

evidence.proved: 'PDF files have a much larger size limit of 500 MB'; non-PDF 'up to 25 MB'
